sentences.text: 9 05-12-2025 Heard learned counsel for the parties.

2. Petitioner apprehends arrest in a case registered for the offence punishable under sections 420,
406/34 of the Indian Penal Code.

3. As per prosecution case, petitioner being President of Chandradei PACS, Araria defalcated Rs.44,70,725/- of the Purnia District Central Co-0perative Bank Ltd.
4.

entities.text: Purnia District Central Co-0perative Bank Ltd.
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Learned counsel appearing for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is elected president of the PACS concerned and he never defalcated any amount of cash credit loan but due to village politics, the Block Co-operative Extension Officer, Araria lodged the present case with false and fabricated allegations.

5. Learned counsel for the State and opposite party Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.40636 of 2024(9) dt.05-12-2025 no.2 oppose the prayer for bail submitting that there is specific allegation against the petitioner that he along with other co- accused defalcated Rs.44,70,725/- of the Purnia District Central Co-operative Bank Ltd.

entities.text: Purnia District Central Co-operative Bank Ltd.
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: 6. Considering the nature of accusation, prayer for bail of the petitioner is rejected.
